verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs say it provides auto-instrumentation for popular frameworks, explicitly naming LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK (plus LlamaIndex, DSPy and Mastra). It describes this as first-class instrumentation built on OpenTelemetry/OpenInference, offers zero-config `auto_instrument=True` tracing, and provides a CLI setup command. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OpenAI SDK tracing integration (OpenAI is named only as an evaluation adapter), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the integrations work as documented.
